description: This file defines an abstract class MaxMinBase in the statistical calculation namespace of the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides a protected static method for datatype adjustments allowing string inputs, possibly used as a base class for Max/Min functions.

classes.name: MaxMinBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing utility methods for statistical calculations related to maximum and minimum value computations.

methods.name: datatypeAdjustmentAllowStrings
methods.description: A protected static method that adjusts data types, converting booleans to integers and strings to zero, facilitating statistical calculations.
